gloss: orally; verbally; by word of mouth

definitions.gloss: orally; verbally; by word of mouth
definitions.explanation: Doing something through spoken words rather than in writing. Used to specify that communication, instructions, or agreements are made verbally. 口頭 alone is a noun meaning "oral/verbal."

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}で{説明|せつめい}する。
{契約|けいやく}は{口頭|こうとう}ではなく{書面|しょめん}で{交|か}わすべきだ。
examples.english: Contracts should be made in writing, not verbally.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}では{口頭|こうとう}で{自分|じぶん}の{経験|けいけん}や{強|つよ}みを{伝|つた}える{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: In an interview, you need to convey your experience and strengths verbally.

notes:
FORMS:
- {口頭|こうとう} (noun): oral, verbal
- {口頭|こうとう}の (adjectival): oral, verbal — {口頭|こうとう}の{約束|やくそく} (verbal promise)
- {口頭|こうとう}で (adverbial): orally, verbally

COMPOUNDS:
- {口頭|こうとう}{試問|しもん} (oral examination)
- {口頭|こうとう}{弁論|べんろん} (oral argument, in court)
- {口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう} (oral presentation)
- {口頭|こうとう}{注意|ちゅうい} (verbal warning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {口頭|こうとう}で vs. {書面|しょめん}で: Oral vs. written. These are frequently contrasted in legal, business, and academic contexts.
- {口頭|こうとう} vs. {口|くち}で: {口|くち}で is more casual and everyday. {口頭|こうとう} is formal and used in official or professional contexts.
